data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'shafa' which means to purify, cleanse or make clear. The name Chafika represents a pure, clear, and radiant soul. The name Chafika carries the meaning “Pure, Clear, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Chafika usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, clear, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
